reviews.title: Would be a nice simple app but isn’t reliable
reviews.text: A nice simple app, which does something that really should have been built in to iOS. Sadly it’s let down by not being very reliable. Sometimes it just fails to print with no indication. Of why or if it is doing anything.

reviews.title: Good idea but..
reviews.text:
I have had nothing it trouble using it on my iPhone ..I cannot get it to print to the correct size paper even when I select it..I have to export it as a jpeg and that does not give me an option to change the paper size from letter ..no
Option for anything smaller. 
I am thinking this purchase was kind of a waste of money.

reviews.title: Could have been great
reviews.text: This could've been great, except it has an annoying feature that forces images to snap to arbitrarily defined points along a grid, and this prevents you from lining up more than one photo right at the edge of the printable area. You can put the first photograph wherever you want to, but after that, all the other photographs are snapped in some non-transparently defined relationship to that first photograph. That prevents you from evenly using all of the space on your page
